title: Porphyrin–azoheteroarenes: synthesis, photophysical, and computational studies
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,28240-28247
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03790E, Paper

Sahana Nagesh Shet, Vighneshwar Ganesh Bhat, Swathi S. G., Udaya Kumar Dalimba, Vijayendra S. Shetti
This paper presents the synthesis, experimental studies, and computational analysis of a new class of hybrid molecules called porphyrin–azopyrroles and porphyrin–azoindoles, which feature porphyrins containing five-membered meso-substituents.
